responses: The ShadowFox AIML Internship is a 4-week intensive program. Week 1 covers Image Tagging (Beginner), Week 2 is Loan/Car Price Prediction (Intermediate), and Weeks 3-4 involve Advanced projects like AI Chatbots and LLM Deployment!
Our internship runs for 4 weeks with progressive difficulty levels. You'll work on 3-4 major projects ranging from beginner CNN models to advanced LLM deployments.
The program is structured as a 4-week journey: starting with foundational projects in Week 1, intermediate challenges in Week 2, and culminating with advanced AI implementations in Weeks 3-4.

You'll learn TensorFlow, Keras for deep learning, Scikit-learn for traditional ML, NLTK for NLP, and Hugging Face for LLM deployment. Plus Python best practices, data preprocessing, and model evaluation techniques!

The internship covers: CNNs for image classification, Random Forest for regression, Neural Networks for chatbots, and Transformer models for NLP. You'll also master data augmentation, hyperparameter tuning, and model deployment.

Key skills include: Deep Learning (TensorFlow/Keras), Machine Learning (Scikit-learn), Natural Language Processing (NLTK), LLM Integration (Hugging Face), and professional development practices like Git and documentation.

You'll build 4 amazing projects: 1) Image Classification CNN for CIFAR-10, 2) Car Price Prediction using Random Forest, 3) This AI Chatbot you're talking to, and 4) An LLM deployment project using Hugging Face!

The projects include: an Image Tagging system with TensorFlow, a Price Prediction model with hyperparameter tuning, a Context-Aware Chatbot with Tkinter GUI, and a Language Model deployment with advanced NLP capabilities.
Your portfolio will showcase: Computer Vision (CNN), Regression Analysis (Random Forest), Conversational AI (this chatbot!), and Generative AI (LLM deployment). All industry-relevant skills!
